name: Besan Ladoo
description: Round gram flour sweets roasted in ghee with sugar and cardamom, rolled into golden balls for festive occasions.
ingredients: a handful of fresh mint, chopped
instructions: Preheat your oven (or set up your steamer or frying station) and lightly grease your pan or molds with ghee.
In a large bowl, whisk together the naan bread and garam masala until evenly combined.
In a separate bowl, blend the plain yogurt with the water until smooth and well incorporated.
Gently fold the wet mixture into the dry ingredients, taking care not to overmix.
Transfer everything to your prepared pan or molds and cook — bake, steam, chill, or fry — until set, about 25 mins.
Remove from the heat and let it cool completely; this helps the texture firm up perfectly.
Garnish with mint or a dusting of lemon wedges.
Slice or portion into servings and serve.
tips: This keeps well for a couple of days in an airtight container, and the flavor often improves overnight.
Bring your plain yogurt to room temperature before mixing for a smoother, more even texture.
